assertions.text: List values use bracket syntax like [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci], not comma-separated strings without brackets.
Empty list input uses [] (not a blank cell).
assertions.evidence: Empty tag list returns empty list | [] | tech | []

assertions.text: Values containing pipes, brackets, or colons are properly quoted.
Set<String> values use curly brace syntax like {tech, dev}, distinct from list brackets.
assertions.evidence: Optional adds one extra category's tags | tech | {biz} | [...]

assertions.text: A cell value containing a newline does not break the table row structure.
assertions.evidence: "tech:java\\nEnterprise Edition" — escaped \n used, then resolved via tag.replace("\\n", "\n")

assertions.text: Values containing pipe characters are quoted so they don't conflict with the column separator.
Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Filtered tags?' or 'Result?')
Test method body contains no if or switch statements
Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: 3 @TableTest method name(s) read as descriptive titles (no @DisplayName needed)

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
assertions.evidence: @Description uses text block or is short single-line

assertions.text: The build file (build.gradle) includes org.tabletest:tabletest-junit as a test dependency
No collection value in any table contains a blank element.
assertions.evidence: Checked all list/set cells (e.g. ["tech:java", "dev:python"], {biz}) — no blank elements found within any collection

assertions.text: An empty tag is written as a quoted empty string, not a blank element (or expressed via a dedicated column).
assertions.evidence: Empty tag string is never kept | '' | tech | [] — uses dedicated String column, quoted empty string

assertions.text: The generated test code compiles successfully against the project scaffolding
